captions: Your dashboard and website actions
This is an ordinary customer workspace. Willow Studio is our fictional demo website.
The summary shows your websites, published sites, AI builds, and current package.
Each website card has its own editor, analytics, publishing, test link, and AI actions.
The editor has sections on the left, your website in the middle, and Properties on the right.
Review your changes, then Save. Publish separately when you are ready to go live.
Add a website page or blog post
Use + Blog / Page in the top bar to create content inside this website.
Choose New website page. For a post and blog listing, choose Blog post instead.
Enter a clear topic and review the URL slug created from the title.
Provide the audience, keywords, purpose, and verified facts you want the page to use.
An optional cover needs both a subject description and visual style.
Choose Generate content when your brief is ready. This walkthrough stops before submitting an AI job.
Review your changes, then Save. Publish separately when you are ready to go live.
Add sections and build without AI
Choose the page first, then add a section in the left panel.
AI chooses layout creates a section from your topic and instructions.
I choose layout lets you browse component families and choose a starting layout.
A blank section gives you a clean starting point with no AI generation.
Choose a destination section, then one of the 14 available object types.
Your new heading is selected. Use Properties to edit its text and styling.
Review your changes, then Save. Publish separately when you are ready to go live.
Select and style a component
Click an object to select it. Double-click editable text when you want to type.
The toolbar changes with your selection: text, image, button, field, or container.
Set a font, size, emphasis, colour, and alignment for the selected text.
Spacing controls adjust padding inside the object and margins around it.
Borders controls colour, width, style, and corner radius.
Move into section chooses a destination. Layers controls stacking when objects overlap.
Review your changes, then Save. Publish separately when you are ready to go live.
Use Section, Page, Theme, and Integrations
Section properties change the selected section’s content, background, and available layout variants.
Page properties contain page rewriting, the page title, H1, and search settings.
Update the SEO title, description, keywords, canonical path, and page indexing.
Theme controls shared design: logo, header appearance, buttons, palette, and typography.
Check changes across several pages. An individual object can override theme defaults.
Integrations includes site indexing, Search Console verification, GA4, reCAPTCHA, and custom scripts.
Review your changes, then Save. Publish separately when you are ready to go live.
Replace, resize, or generate an image
Select the exact image you want to change.
Use width and height to resize. Fill / crop fills the box; Fit whole image shows the full picture.
Replace image offers a file upload, your project image library, or an image URL.
Choose an existing project image from the library. These are demo assets, not customer photos.
For an AI replacement, describe what the image should show and choose the visual direction.
Generate only when the instructions are ready. This demo does not submit a generation request.
Review your changes, then Save. Publish separately when you are ready to go live.
